coordinated_activities.activity: Waking up, showering and getting washed for the day (bathroom used early so it is free for Member 4's 06:45-07:15 slot)
Getting dressed for the day, packing the study bag and reviewing the day's schedule
Making and eating breakfast (toast and tea) together with Member 4 while checking phone messages
Commuting to Monash University campus by public transport, departing at the same time as Member 4
Attending Master of Education lectures and tutorials on campus
Eating lunch on campus and reviewing lecture notes
Studying in the campus library, reading research papers and working on assignment drafts on the computer
Commuting home from campus by public transport
Cooking and eating dinner together with Member 2 and Member 4
Washing dishes and wiping down shared kitchen counters together with Member 2
Changing into part-time work uniform and packing a small bag for the shift
Traveling to the part-time hospitality and retail job
Working the evening shift in hospitality and retail (serving customers, restocking, closing tasks)
Traveling home after finishing the shift
Washing up and brushing teeth before bed (bathroom free after Member 4 finished at 23:00 and before Member 3 goes to sleep)
Winding down on the phone and setting an alarm before sleeping
